mechanism: Apply Lopez de Prado FFD: scalar-product of log-prices with binomial weights ω_k for real d∈(0,1), truncating |ω_k|<τ, yielding a series that is more stationary as d↑ while retaining long-range price-level memory (unlike integer differencing which erases memory).
data_needed: log close series; differentiation degree d; weight threshold τ; history depth
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD M15 (EA test); chart symbol generic
why_new_for_mis: Gives MIS a tunable memory-vs-stationarity transform for ML/regime features instead of crude returns that wipe path memory.
quote: how to differentiate a time series to make it stationary and at the same time to preserve the maximum possible amount of memory

idea_name: SampEn on binarized FFD increments as persistence/irregularity sensor
mechanism: After fractional differentiation, binarize increments BinInc∈{+1,−1}; compute Sample Entropy (m≈2, r≈0.2·std) in a sliding window (e.g. 50). Low SampEn ⇒ high persistence (runs of same sign); high SampEn ⇒ irregular/unpredictable path—separating irregularity from mere std-dev volatility.
data_needed: FFD series; entropy window; m,r; optional cross-SampEn of two series
why_new_for_mis: Separates path irregularity/persistence from amplitude volatility as an orthogonal sensor usable with FFD features.
quote: ApEn provides an estimate of irregularity. Moreover, the degree of variability is not very critical, while irregularity and unpredictability are really a problem.

idea_name: Prior-bar direction gate as local-trend regime filter
mechanism: Only place grid limit orders in the direction of the previous completed bar on a chosen TF (best MN for EURUSD, D1 for AUDUSD/AUDCAD): if prior bar up → Long-only grid; if down → Short-only. Optionally require bars 0 and 1 aligned.
data_needed: OHLC of filter TF; boolean Use entry by bar; bar index; timeframe
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD,AUDUSD,AUDCAD; EA on M5; filter TF MN or D1; decade-3 (10-pt) grid; 2015–2019
why_new_for_mis: Simple multi-TF bar-direction regime bit that gates one-sided exposure without needing complex trend indicators.
quote: If the price moved upwards on a previous bar, trade Long only and vice versa.

mechanism: Hard bounds Do-not-open-Long/Short if price </> configured levels taken from multi-year W1/MN range (e.g. EURUSD ~1.093–1.178). Outside the range the EA abstains; inside it runs the floating decade grid.

quote: if the price is located in a range on W1 or MN chart, its trading results should be better

idea_name: Pivot Mean (price/CMA) normalized spread from cumulative mean
mechanism: CMA via running sum/counter from a start time; PM_t = price_t / CMA_t (e.g. 1.0035 ⇒ +0.35% above CMA). Converts any series into a cross-comparable normalized distance-to-life-mean feature; sideways price drifts toward CMA.
data_needed: open/close from startingTime; running sums and counter
why_new_for_mis: Life-mean relative level sensor with cross-instrument comparability without fixed-window MA support/resistance.
quote: PM provides a quick numerical understanding of the distance of price from the CMA. This means that PM can be considered as a measure of spread.

idea_name: PMO as divergence of MAs on close-PM vs open-PM
mechanism: PMO = SMA(PM_close, m) − SMA(PM_open, n); zero-line crosses and peak/trough reversals as early warnings; distribution of PMO≈bell around 0 usable for thresholds. Unlike MACD, operates on PM spreads not raw price EMAs.
data_needed: PM close/open buffers; MA lengths m,n (e.g. 3,21 or 1,5)
why_new_for_mis: Momentum-of-normalized-spread oscillator with quasi-Gaussian null for calibrated overbought/oversold sensing.
quote: PMO provides a measure of divergence between two spreads

idea_name: Bollinger channel width vs k·ATR flat/range gate
mechanism: IsRange: if (BB_upper−BB_lower) < InpATRCoeff·ATR → declare flat and refuse pending entries; only when channel width ≥ k·ATR place trend-aligned limit at BB border. Separates expandable-vol regimes from compressed flat.
data_needed: BB period/deviation; ATR period; coefficient k; BB and MA TFs
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD and multi-symbol portfolio; InpBBTF/InpMATF e.g. M15; live VPS signal ~9 months
why_new_for_mis: Volatility-normalized channel-width flat detector that gates mean-reversion entries only when the band is wide enough.
quote: Channel width below k*ATR indicates a flat, and thus placing orders is not allowed.

idea_name: Fast/Slow EMA relative position as binary trend regime
mechanism: TrendCalculate: after flat check, trend=+1 if FastEMA>SlowEMA else −1; BuyLimit only on uptrend at lower BB, SellLimit on downtrend at upper BB. Always-on trend unless flat gate zeros it.
why_new_for_mis: Classic but explicitly coupled to ATR-scaled flat gate as a three-state (up/down/flat) regime sensor.
quote: If the Fast EMA is above the Slow EMA, an uptrend is defined. The downtrend is recognized when the lines are arranged the opposite way.

idea_name: Point-move block discretization and trendiness vs random-walk reference
mechanism: Rebuild price as fixed-size point blocks (step = N points). Over W steps (e.g. 40) and many samples, compare empirical vertical-amplitude density to combinatorial RW reference (p_rev=0.5). Wider/heavier tails than reference ⇒ continuation prob >50% (trend); narrower ⇒ reversal>50% (flat). Trendiness = ref_count/meas_count in central band or meas_avg_amp/ref_avg_amp.
data_needed: tick/M1 path; block size; sample count; step horizon; reference table
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: GBPUSD blocks 0.00022; EURUSD; BTCUSD; AMD/AAPL; Brent; AFLT/GAZP/SBER; multi-scale block sizes ×1.1
why_new_for_mis: Operational definition of trend vs flat as deviation of continuation probability from 50% RW null, with a scalar trendiness score.
quote: In case of a trend movement, the probability of a trend continuation exceeds the trend reversal probability.

mechanism: Recompute trendiness across growing block sizes and across step counts 10…100; FX often high-trendiness on small scale → ~1 (RW) on large scale; stocks may stay trendy; asymmetry of density flags directional bias (e.g. AMD up-skew).
data_needed: same block engine; scale ladder; horizon ladder
why_new_for_mis: Gives MIS a scale-dependent regime fingerprint and capital-flow interpretation (speculative vs investment) without parameter optimization.
quote: Most developed currency pairs have a weak trend that decreases with increasing scale and trading volume.
